articles.title: Patrick Sandoval gave the Red Sox a chance in his debut in the intense Yankees rivalry
articles.description: Playing for the first time in the cauldron of a Red Sox-Yankees game, Sandoval allowed one run on three hits over 5⅓ innings with four walks and seven strikeouts.

articles.title: Red Sox bats go silent in the Bronx, as Cam Schlittler, Yankees win first of four-game series
articles.description: Chad Tracy's crew had just five hits and left 10 on base as Boston was shut out for the second straight game for the first time in almost three years.

articles.title: Why the Red Sox didn’t activate Roman Anthony or Trevor Story for start of Yankees series
articles.description: The best-case scenario is the pair will join the big club for Sunday's series finale at Yankee Stadium, but there's no guarantee that will happen.

articles.title: After moving so many pitching prospects, do the Red Sox have enough to replenish their system?
articles.description: The Red Sox pitching pipeline looks very different now that 22 pitchers moved in 15 deals.

articles.title: Game 134: Red Sox to face Yankees in four-game series starting Friday in New York; lineups and notes
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval will be on the mound for Boston, and New York will pitch Cam Schlittler. The game will air on Apple TV

articles.title: Unheralded (until recently) Mickey Gasper embodies the never-say-die Red Sox in this incredible season
articles.description: Just like the longtime minor leaguer was, this team was written off early in the season. Now, they're both winning big-time.

articles.title: Tampa approves $2.3 billion deal for a new Rays ballpark
articles.description: The 4-3 vote by the Tampa City Council came three months after a tentative agreement was reached for a stadium, which would include $967 million in tax money.

articles.title: A four-game sweep against the Yankees in June got the Red Sox started on their 41-14 run
articles.description: The Red Sox are seeking to be the top wild card team, which would put them at Fenway Park throughout the best-of-three Wild Card Series.

articles.title: These reborn Red Sox are magical, but the old-school skeptic keeps screaming there’s a catch to this run
articles.description: It’s harder and harder by the day to doubt this team, but does all this juju and voodoo carry an inevitable expiration date?

articles.title: Which version of Trevor Story can the Red Sox expect?
articles.description: While the veteran shortstop acknowledged there will be a buildup needed, he also believes he has the ability to be a difference-maker in the playoffs.

articles.title: Some Red Sox players have taken the hobby of card collecting to the next level: ‘It’s a rush’
articles.description: It’s been common for the team to arrive with multiple cars filled with players to descend en masse on shops.

articles.title: ‘Mickey Jones’ has stepped in nicely for the Red Sox since Masataka Yoshida went on the injured list
articles.description: Mickey Gasper and Jahmai Jones were 12 for 23 with nine extra-base hits and 12 RBIs over the eight games after Yoshida strained his left hamstring on Aug. 15.

articles.title: Red Sox are listless and sloppy in shut-out loss to Marlins ending five-game win streak
articles.description: By any measure, it was one of their worst games of the season.

articles.title: Game 133: Red Sox go for sweep of Marlins
articles.description: Sonny Gray will be on the mound in Miami when the Red Sox look to extend their winning streak to six games.

articles.title: Roman Anthony, Trevor Story think they’ll be with Red Sox this weekend for Yankees series
articles.description: The pair, continuing rehab assignments with Triple-A Worcester, hope to rejoin big club on the road for four games in New York.

articles.title: ‘It was stressful, to be honest’: Jarren Duran delivers with 11th-inning grand slam to lift Red Sox over Marlins
articles.description: Mickey Gasper added two solo home runs as Boston, on a five-game win streak, improved to a season-high 14 games above .500.
